Name: Milcah
Summary: Milcah was the daughter of Haran and the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother. She bore him eight children, including Bethuel, the father of Rebekah.
KeyStory: Through Milcah's son Bethuel came Rebekah, the wife of Isaac — so the promise line passed through her family too.
RelatedPeople: Haran; Nahor, Brother of Abraham; Bethuel; Rebekah
LifeLesson: God often works His promises through mothers whose names history nearly forgets.
